executed.title: Atomic project save pattern and content-hash identity
executed.rationale: The brief requires recovery after interrupted save and stable source identity.
executed.expected: failed write leaves target unchanged; replace succeeds; hashes are byte-sensitive; crash before replace can leave temp file.
executed.stdout:
target intact after failed save : True True
no leftover temp visible?  files: ['.project-z57qhje0.tmp', 'project.json']
after successful save           : {"v": 2, "ann": ["ok"]}
identity hash stable            : True
any byte change alters identity : True
same-dir rename supported       : True
scope_limits: local tmpfs/ext filesystem; no power-loss/crash injection beyond exception before replace

proposed_unexecuted.title: Reopen round-trip on a second machine
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Move/copy project and reference sources to a second path; reopen and compare annotation rows and relocation prompts.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Rows remain identical; hash mismatch never relinks silently.

proposed_unexecuted.title: 3 GB bounded-read benchmark
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Measure p95 tile latency, peak RSS, prefetch, and cancel latency on synthetic tiled OME-TIFF and a real instrument file on the target workstation.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: p95 <100 ms, RSS <4 GB, cancel <250 ms; thresholds are proposed and need team confirmation.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Interrupt save/export on shared storage
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Kill mid-save and mid-export on the team's actual NFS/SMB share; reopen and inspect partial/temp recovery.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Last good project state remains recoverable and no partial output becomes authoritative.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Sample-index calibration and export round-trip
proposed_unexecuted.plan: With x/y scales (0.25, 0.5) µm and origin (12, 7) µm, verify index points (0,0) and (1.5,2.25) map to (12,7) and (12.375,8.125) µm. Round-trip through the workspace CSV/GeoJSON writer and parser; inspect manifest convention, axes, units, source identity, and transforms. Probe edge-origin conversion separately.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Workspace parser recovers binary64 sample indices exactly; expected physical values and declared sample-center origin match. This is an own-implementation check, not generic GeoJSON/third-party interoperability.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Cross-filesystem relocation (EXDEV path)
proposed_unexecuted.plan: Move a project across mounts; verify same-directory temporary saves or a safe fallback.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: No partial authoritative project state after failure.

proposed_unexecuted.title: Per-instrument calibration fixture
proposed_unexecuted.plan: For each instrument, assert imported value and unit against a reviewed fixture and detect reader-upgrade drift, following the tifffile #319 test pattern.
proposed_unexecuted.acceptance: Any unreviewed value/unit semantic change fails visibly.
